threads.title: Welcome to the kids forum!
threads.author: Shaiq Muhammad
threads.body: Assalamu alaikum students! This is a safe place to ask kind questions about lessons, share what you learned, and encourage each other. Be respectful, use your first name only, and never share private information (phone, address, passwords).

replies.author: Amina
replies.body: JazakAllahu khairan! Excited to learn here.

threads.title: Quran study tips — what helps you?
threads.author: Shaiq Muhammad
threads.body: Share one tip that helps you when reading or reviewing Quran (with meaning). Keep answers short and kind.
